liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Garcia shaped his solos deliberately through his effects during a slick performance [10]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): The performance was called the best 1980s Sugaree, described as incredibly sweet [17]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Brent was noted for playing the organ terrifically well on Little Red Rooster [12]
- **Deal** (1 review): Garcia played Other One-style solos during a strong version of Deal [10]
- **Drums** (1 review): The jamming following the drums was described as incredibly sick [11]

## The recordings

- **gd81-03-28.fm.hanno.3306.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 200 min; rated 3.95/5 by 39 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording quality was criticized as lousy, despite a nice Shakedown Street; The audio is tinny and echoey, though slightly better than the June 21, 1984 recording [13][16]
- **gd1981-03-28.140323.fm.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: FM broadcast; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1981-03-28.fm.hajo.franka.85958.flac16**: FM broadcast; 22 songs; 196 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [5]
- **gd1981-03-28.136977.FM-UK.flac24**: FM broadcast; 24 songs; 193 min [3]

## Around the show

- Pete Townshend joined the band for Not Fade Away, Wharf Rat, and Around and Around [9]
- Townshend was only distinctly audible on Not Fade Away, adding little else [16]
- The Grugahalle in Essen was rocking, and the band played well outside the USA [19]
- Flying Karamazov Brothers were on stage during the Drums segment [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-03-28.fm.hanno.3306.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard - FM [1]. Also: Stereo FM source transferred to reel master, DAT, CDWAV, and CDR via Hanno Bunjes [1]
- **gd1981-03-28.140323.fm.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Master FM Cassette > Dat 16/48 [2]
- **gd1981-03-28.fm.hajo.franka.85958.flac16**: taped by HaJo; transferred by franka; source: FM (live broadcast) > Revox A76 Tuner > Revox A77 (1/2 track, 3 1/2 ips, TDK LX 35) [5]. Also: Pete Townshend played guitar from Not Fade Away through Around and Around [5]
- **gd1981-03-28.136977.FM-UK.flac24**: source: Recording [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1981-03-28 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1981-03-28-backstage-pass/) [21]
